_comment: Gemini CLI — .gemini/settings.json in the repo, or ~/.gemini/settings.json. `httpUrl` is streamable HTTP; `url` is the older SSE transport. Use httpUrl for all four once serena moves. Gemini CLI has no skills mechanism and no hooks: everything the hooks enforce must also be prose in the instruction file, which is why each hook ships with a rule line.

context._comment: NEEDS A MANUAL CHECK on the installed version: Gemini CLI's context file is GEMINI.md by default, and recent builds accept a list of context file names so AGENTS.md can be added. If the installed build has no such setting, bootstrap.sh symlinks GEMINI.md -> AGENTS.md instead.
